test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state is the largest in terms of the outstanding portfolio of microfinance loans, as per the MFIN Micrometer Q4 FY21-22?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• MFIN Micrometer Q4 FY21-22 Report:-

 
 
• **According to the MFIN Micrometer Q4 FY21-22 report, Tamil Nadu is the largest state in terms of the outstanding portfolio of microfinance loans. **
 
• It has a portfolio outstanding of ₹36,806 crore, followed by Bihar (₹35,941 crore) and West Bengal (₹34,016 crore).
